skill.name: application-patterns
skill.description: Common application development patterns and implementations

generated_query: I'm building a task management app with Next.js and need help implementing several common patterns. First, I need a user registration form with client- and server-side validation using Zod; the server action should create the user in the database and return a structured error object if the email already exists. Second, I need a login flow that validates email/password against bcrypt hashes and sets a JWT in an httpOnly cookie. Third, I need an admin dashboard page that displays all tasks in a data table with server-side pagination, sorting by any column, filtering by status/priority, and bulk selection with a "Delete Selected" button that performs a soft delete (sets `deletedAt`). Finally, users should be able to upload a profile avatar: the frontend requests a presigned upload URL from the server, then uploads directly to S3. Can you provide example code for each piece (validation schemas, server actions, hooks, table component) and explain the data flow?

edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the duplicate email error handling in the registration server action means the skill no longer provides the structured error response that the user explicitly requires.
